verses.text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

segments.text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

segments.text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

segments.text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.text: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

segments.text: He asked life of thee,
and
thou gavest
it
him,
even
length of days for ever and ever.

verses.text: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

segments.text: His glory
is
great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

segments.text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

notes: 21.6 made him most…: Heb. set him to be blessings
21.6 made him exceeding…: Heb. make him glad with joy

verses.text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

segments.text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

segments.text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

segments.text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

segments.text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.text: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

segments.text: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device,
which
they are not able
to perform

verses.text: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

segments.text: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back,
when
thou shalt make ready
thine arrows
upon thy strings against the face of them.

notes: 21.12 shalt thou…: or, thou shalt set them as a butt

verses.text: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

segments.text: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength:
so
will we sing and praise thy power.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
